properties.digitized_from: Real block boundary from real street geometry (src/block_fit.py load_blocks(), trimmed against src/street_geometry.py's fuller street buffer); the plan's own A/B internal split has no mapped street, so it's a straight bisection along the block's long axis, not a real line.
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-19 for the block-by-block plan walk-through (docs/briefs/mission_bay_block_inventory.csv), per the Mission Rock transform-and-register precedent for unbuilt blocks. West half of the parking lot west of the Owens St curve, north of Nelson Rising Lane. CORRECTED 2026-09-20: the owner reviewed a numbered real-gap-fragment map of this area and determined the parking lot previously split between this record and 18B (divided by an arbitrary bisection line, per the original 2026-09-19 note) is actually all one real block -- 18A. Merged in the former 18B polygon; the real 18B is a separate building complex further east (fragments 7+11+12 from the numbered map, morphologically closed to bridge two internal walkway strips -- see that record). The merged shape already stops ~14m short of the new 18B building on its own (a real access lane/driveway gap), so no additional east truncation was needed beyond that natural boundary.
properties.accuracy_caveat: PARTIALLY REAL -- the outer boundary is a real polygonized city block from real street geometry, not hand-traced; only the internal A/B split line is approximate (a bisection, since no real street divides this block into A and B).
properties.notes: No building on this site as of 2026-09-19 (satellite- and building-footprint-confirmed); currently an operating surface parking lot west of the Owens St curve. The OCII plan's own Dec 2019 Land Use Map designates this block for future UCSF institutional use, consistent with the rest of this campus row, but no specific project, developer, or timeline was found in this pass.
